comment: This project no longer runs the app — DamnLease serves from Cloudflare
Workers at damnlease.com. What's left here is a forwarding address, so
links people already have (shared listings, delivered push notifications,
bookmarks of doorlynyc.vercel.app) still land on the real site instead of
a stale copy writing to the same database.
Cron is gone too: the hourly poll is a Cloudflare cron trigger now, and
Vercel's Hobby plan could only ever fire it once a day.
